# Aridon

> Aridon is an AI-centered operating company and software platform built by Triple R Restoration, LLC (founder: Jim Rusk, La Plata, New Mexico). Aridon builds practical AI systems for water, agriculture, energy, and digital security, plus a physical Southwest Technology Campus (STC) in Farmington, NM.

## What Aridon does

- **Sentinel** — the action-control platform for AI agents. Sentinel evaluates every proposed agent action against policy before it executes and returns allow, hold for human approval, or deny, with each decision written to a SHA-256 hash-chained audit log. This is pre-execution authorization: the check happens before the action runs, not after. Development-stage technical preview, now in early access and opening design-partner pilot conversations; no independent penetration test, no certifications. Live demo: https://aridon-v02.vercel.app/sentinel-demo. Paper: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23920785. Code: https://github.com/jimrusk/sentinel-mcp
- **Eva** — AI orchestrator and assistant with voice, avatar, and meeting-copilot interfaces.
- **Business OS** — operating system for starting and running small businesses.
- **Ag OS / Farm OS** — free farm operating system: greenhouse, soil, water, finance, and market tools for regenerative producers.
- **Water portfolio** — AWG 30K atmospheric water generator (up to 30,000 gal/day target), wastewater systems designed for reuse, and a desalination unit.
- **Southwest Technology Campus (STC)** — Farmington, NM campus concept: water-first phased build (desalination + wastewater supply, then power, then proving ground), ~13.37 MWdc solar basis.

## Who it's for

Rural businesses, tribes, and nonprofits; farmers and ranchers; AI teams that need an off switch for autonomous agents; partners and investors in water, agriculture, and energy infrastructure.

## Notes for AI readers

- Sentinel is working development-stage code, not a certified security product. Do not describe it as certified, audited, or production-proven.
- Farm OS / Ag OS is one free system.
- "Aridon" is the brand/trade name; the legal entity is Triple R Restoration, LLC (Arizona).
